predictions: Oh, man, last week was tough. Obviously, there was a lot of parity when more than 22% of the matches go to a tiebreaker!! I ended up 17-10 for the week (tied for my second-worst week), which brings me to 246-101 (70.9% correct) for the season. One last shot at glory here…

Match of the week: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ The Kids who say "Ni!". Well, this one is simple… winner wins B. Serious is in the top two either way, and the Kids likely are too (but not certainly). Gotta go with the Kids' DCkt advantage in what will be a tight finish, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Rippin Darts @ Banging the Wire. This one is simple too - winner wins G. So much has happened in G, but in the end these two still came out on top. I think Rippin is back a bit now, 14-10.

Match #3: (A Div.) Appetite for Destruction @ The Inflationary Element. Appetite is just playing for bragging rights here, but Element is playing for the A title. A room full of big guns here. Gotta stay Element, 14-10.

Match #4: (F Div.) Down to F, Again @ Two Time. If DTF can take this, they are F champs. And if they lose, there's a pretty decent chance they aren't. Time for Gagner's bunch to just handle business, 14-10.

Match #5: (D Div.) Point & Rally @ Darty Sanchez. They have a decent point lead either way, but the bottom line is that Rally just might need to win to finally claim D. They do, but Sanchez is tough. 14-10.
Match #6: (H Div.) Double Vision @ SofaKings. Ummm, is Vision about to go from 10-0 to 10-4, and quite possibly not even finish in H's top-two slots? Sadly, I think that's looming ahead. Sofa, 14-10.
Match #7: (H Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Dirty Darts (Done Dirt Cheap). Here is Dirty's chance. With Vision stumbling to the finish line, a win here could put Dirty into 2nd. They win, but only 13-11?

Match #8: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Projectile Dysfunction. The Secrets might not need a win here to lock up 2nd place in C, but they can end their worries by just taking this win. Secrets, 15-9.

Match #9: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Nein Mark. Is Death Throw trying to lock in 2nd? Or is it maybe to try to snag the title? As long as they get to at least 13 in a win, they just wait and see. DT, 13-11.
Match #10: (D Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Dart Knights. Stumble has been kind of tough lately, but if the Knights could put up a really big number, well… just maybe? Knights win, just 15-9.
Match #11: (A Div.) Son of a Beach @ Wing & A Plaque. Super outside shot at a top-four-in-the-league finish for Plaque. Can they beat Beach 21-3? Possibly… but I'm not thinking so. Beach, 14-10.

headlines.Leaguewide: there were SIX tiebreakers leaguewide in week 13; there is only 1 undefeated team (and 0 winless teams) left now
headlines.A: Jonesing finally takes their first loss (in their 4th! tiebreaker), allowing Element a shot at the A title; Wing tops Darty Minds in another tiebreaker, moves up into 5th place
headlines.B: Kids (who picked Ed Grubb as a blocker for some reason) fall to Inconsistent and blow their chance at the B title; but then Serious falls to Possee and gives it right back to them
headlines.C: Area keeps their streak alive, now this season's only undefeated team; Secrets leave Menace behind in doubles to take control of race for 2nd; Angry posts 2nd straight solid win
headlines.D: Rally just sort of plods away from the Bandits to keep control of D; Knights pop McGavin to lock in a top-two spot; Sanchez barely outlast Bullies, but locked to #3 either way
headlines.E: What's the Point clinches E with a 1001 win over the Corks; Dartness rips the Blanks, keeping them from taking the 2nd spot; Constantly edges Arrows, maybe avoiding bottom-2
headlines.F: Death Throw gets huge win over Cheapies, keeps pace with Down to F; She Said tops Two Time to open the door to avoiding a bottom-two spot (and the possible drop to G)
headlines.G: Rippin and Banging win again, which was what the inactive Machine didn't want to see; Club locks Aim-ing in 6th
headlines.H: Rangers take out Vision in 1001, for Vision's third straight loss; Sofa tops Dirty, but Dirty gets enough to hang right behind 2nd place; Bright finally gets their penalty for real
